name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-02-02, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
